published_ranges._notes: TDS V1.0 (2025/12/1): nozzles 0.4/0.6/0.8 only, HDT 1.8MPa 52C, melt 155C, fan on. TDS has no hardened-nozzle note (glow pigments are commonly abrasive; consider a hardened nozzle). Retraction/print-speed/chamber label mapping inferred from the flattened PDF layout (value order matches the other Kingroon V1.0 TDS sheets: retraction length, retraction speed, chamber temp, overhang, bridging ... printing speed). Product page not re-read this run. Earlier entry: TDS V1.0: luminous-powder additive; nozzle sizes 0.4/0.6/0.8 only; Cool Plate / High Temperature Plate / Textured PEI with glue; HDT 1.8 MPa 52 C; melting 155 C; PC+ABS spool rated 90 C. Sold as 'Glow in Dark PLA'. Verification 2026-11-01: fields and plate/chamber/fan/retraction ranges confirmed against the TDS PDF; kingroon.com / kingroon3d.com product pages returned HTTP 429, so page-derived notes and conflicts were not re-checked.
